slides.title: What XYZ LE is for
slides.lead: Three ways to use a layout recipe

slides.title: Small edits can trigger a full redesign
slides.lead: Every revision creates another chance for layout drift.

items.title: Generated images
items.body: Regenerating an image can change the composition and artwork along with the text.

items.title: Manual layout
items.body: Copying a design across formats or campaigns means rechecking alignment, spacing and line breaks.

items.title: Repeat production
items.body: Without a saved recipe and inputs, it is hard to reproduce an approved export.

items.title: Author the design
items.body: A designer or AI agent turns a brief into a trusted recipe, editable JSON and optional artwork.

items.title: Render the design
items.body: The engine validates inputs, fits text and embeds bundled fonts. Change the JSON to render the next version.

slides.title: Our recipes on proven renderers
slides.lead: Two backends share the same scene.

items.title: XYZ Layout Engine
items.body: Recipe conventions, fixture validation, fitting, asset checks, catalog pins and export receipts.

items.title: Rendering backends
items.body: Satori lays out the scene and produces SVG. resvg rasterizes it. Playwright runs Chromium for browser rendering.

items.title: For designers
items.body: Set the typography, spacing and artwork once. Change the visual treatment independently of the copy.

items.title: For repeat production
items.body: Feed updated copy or numbers into the same recipe and render offline from a checkout.

slides.title: What makes a render reproducible
slides.lead: The inputs and render environment can be checked in and replayed.

items.title: Editable inputs
items.body: Content is structured JSON. Recipe code defines the canvas, font and layout rules.

items.title: Versioned recipes
items.body: The catalog binds published recipe versions to SHA-256 digests of their declared files.

items.title: Offline rendering
items.body: Bundled fonts and local artwork keep the render independent of model calls and asset downloads.

slides.title: Design patterns and quality checks
slides.lead: Hallmark informs the design. Impeccable audits the rendered HTML.

items.title: Hallmark
items.body: Read layouts and themes from a local clone and adapt them into JSON. The Bento, Stat-Led and Skate Guide examples show the workflow.

items.title: Impeccable
items.body: Run the optional HTML audit to flag contrast, small text and cramped spacing. Use its design guidance to refine the recipe.

slides.note: The Riso edition of this deck adapts the palette from the Hallmark Bento example.

slides.title: What runs XYZ Layout Engine
slides.lead: The local engine runs on Node.js 22.13 or newer.

items.title: Language and data
items.body: JavaScript ES modules define the recipes. JSON files supply the copy, layout inputs and palette.

items.title: Rendering
items.body: Satori produces SVG and resvg converts it to PNG. Playwright drives Chromium for browser rendering.

items.title: Recipe catalog
items.body: SQLite stores recipe versions and SHA-256 digests so the engine can verify the files used in a render.

slides.note: Dependencies are pinned in the pnpm lockfile.
